plain.text: "LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens." Even from the mouths of children and infants God has established strength, to silence his enemies.

"When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place, what is a human being that you are mindful of them, that you care for them?" Yet God made people a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned them with glory and honour.

God made people rulers over the works of his hands and put everything under their feet: flocks and herds, wild animals, birds, and fish of the sea. "LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!"

summary.bigIdea: The God who made the stars cares for human beings and gives them honour and responsibility.
points: God's majesty is seen in all the earth and sky.
Compared with the universe, people seem small, yet God cares for them.
God gives people glory and the job of caring for creation.
summary.reflection: Next time you look at the night sky, what would you like to say to the God who made it, and cares for you?
